issues.description: The template's header for the sphere intersection function declares a different function name than the implementation and the solution header. In template_repository/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h the function is declared as check_sphere_hit(...), but the implementation (template_repository/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.cpp) defines ray_sphere_intersect(...) and the solution header (solution_repository/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h) also declares ray_sphere_intersect(...). This name/signature mismatch will cause compilation/link errors or confusion: students will include the provided header and not find the implementation under the declared name (or call ray_sphere_intersect from main but the header declares check_sphere_hit), preventing them from building or testing their code.
